name: Inferno’s Embrace
source:
Introducing Inferno’s Embrace—where ancient mysteries and hidden societies come alive!

Embark on a journey to Wyverndale Academy, where you’ll uncover a hidden society of dragon hybrids and confront secrets that blur the line between humanity and magic. As dark forces rise, team up with dragons Niko, Vidar, and Dravon to navigate a world torn between peaceful coexistence and looming dominance. Embrace your unique power, balance loyalty and duty, and rewrite your destiny!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.dragonacademy]Google Play[/url]]
